decisions.reason: Separately controlling LED and sensor power does not change which rails are monitored or the current-monitor topology.
The source does not change the use of the addressable LED chain for charge-status indication or its associated connector circuitry.
Separate LED and sensor controls do not alter the standalone USB power source, activation condition, capacity, or powered 3.3V scope.
The source does not add, remove, or redefine any main-board connector.
The source does not change the 3.3V source OR-ing method or source-selection behavior.
Power-control separation does not change the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The source does not concern panel controls, touch inputs, reset wiring, or button placement.
The source establishes separate controls but provides no GPIO assignment and does not change any existing mapped pin.
This switched 5V supply powers both the LEDs and sensors, so the explicit addition of separate controls materially changes its load-control behavior.
